newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Canberra wants coal industry report within a year.
newsitem.headline: Canberra wants coal industry report within a year.

text.p: The Australian government on Wednesday said it had asked the Industry Commission to report within 12 months on an inquiry into the country's largest export earner -- the black coal industry.
"This is an important inquiry given the industry's significance to the economy," Treasurer Peter Costello said in a statement.

Resources and Energy Minister Warwick Parer on Tuesday launched an inquiry into the industry -- worth about A$8.6 billion in revenue in calender 1996 -- aimed at increasing its international competitiveness.
Parer said the government industry adviser, the Industry Commission, would provide a detailed focus of how to improve the performance of the industry.
He said the commission would start the study as soon as possible and report after 12 months.
Costello said the Commission would soon release an issues paper on the inquiry.
